faq.title: Everything you want to know about Ghazala

items.question: Is Ghazala an official WhatsApp Business API provider?
items.answer: Yes, Ghazala is built on Meta's official WhatsApp Business API, ensuring service stability, full compliance with WhatsApp policies, and protection from bans associated with unofficial solutions.

items.question: How long does setup and WhatsApp number connection take?
items.answer: Usually just a few minutes. Register your account, create your organization, then connect your number via Meta's embedded signup without leaving the platform.

items.question: Can multiple agents reply from the same number?
items.answer: Absolutely. The shared inbox is designed for exactly that: your whole team collaborates on one number with conversation assignment, internal notes, and per-agent performance tracking.

items.question: Does the platform integrate with our internal systems?
items.answer: Yes, we provide a fully documented REST API and real-time webhooks, making it easy to connect Ghazala with your CRM, ERP, and e-commerce systems.

items.question: How are WhatsApp message costs calculated?
items.answer: Conversation costs follow Meta's official pricing by template type and country. Ghazala shows you a clear breakdown for every message in the billing dashboard with no hidden fees.

items.question: Is my data and customer conversations secure?
items.answer: We apply encryption in transit and at rest, granular role-based permissions, and full audit logs, with strict adherence to the privacy policy on our website.
